WordPress.org sends the most sign-ups, so its fixes come first within each level.

name.text: Example Booking: Appointment Booking Calendar and Form

short_description.text: Booking plugin for salons, clinics and studios: an online booking calendar and booking form on your site, with deposits and SMS reminders.

screenshot_captions.text: A client books a haircut from the salon's own site in three taps
Pick a service, a staff member and a time
Plugin settings: paste your booking page link

needs_confirmation: Deposits and SMS reminders work through the plugin, not only in the main app

subtitle.text: Appointment booking app for in-store services

introduction.text: Booking calendar for in-store services: customers pick a time, pay a deposit and get reminders.

details.text: Example Booking adds a service booking page to your Shopify theme. Customers choose a service, a staff member and a time, then pay a deposit at Shopify checkout. SMS and email reminders go out before each appointment, and your staff see every booking on one calendar. Built for salons, studios, repair counters and stores that offer fittings or classes.

features.text: Service booking page that matches your theme
Staff booking calendar with one view per staff member

screenshot_captions.text: A customer books an in-store service from the product page
Every booking on the staff calendar

remove: The "Plans from $19 a month" screenshot: no pricing in listing images
needs_confirmation: Repair counters and fittings are real customer types for the Shopify app

name.text: Example Booking for Front Desk: Appointment Scheduler

summary.text: Front desk calendar: see today's schedule and bookings, add one from any tab and get an alert when a client books.

description.text: Example Booking for Front Desk keeps your appointment calendar one click away. See today's schedule, add a booking while you are on the phone, and get an alert when a client books online. Search any appointment by client name. Works with your Example Booking Software account.
